senses.gloss: part. pass. of <cite ref="Q00074"><he>פָּגַם</he></cite>, q. v.

units: <cite ref="Mishnah Kiddushin 3:12">Kidd. III, 12</cite> <he>כל מקום שיש … הולד הולך אחר הפ׳</he> wherever a betrothal is legally recognized, but a sin is connected with it, the issue follows the status of the inferior, e.g. if a high priest marries a widow &c.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 67a:10">Ib. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>הלך אחר הפ׳ שבשניהם</he> (in assigning the legal status of the issue) follow the inferior of the two parents; a. e.
